test_pybind11_simple_setup: test building a pybind11 C++ extension module using Pybind11Extension and setup.py build_ext
test_pybind11_parallel_compile: test parallel compilation of pybind11 extensions by installing ParallelCompile before setup
test_pybind11_cxx_std_flag: test pybind11 extension builds with different C++ standard versions like cxx_std 11 or 0
test_intree_extensions: test the intree_extensions helper to convert relative C++ source paths into Extension objects
test_intree_extensions_package_dir: test intree_extensions with a package_dir mapping to resolve extension names under custom source roots
